login_description: Sign in with your administrator email to continue.
auth_session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
unsaved_changes: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?
activities_description: Activities you can administer, loaded for the visible calendar period.
activities_details: Other admins can see an activity if: they would see it if they were a normal user OR they are admins to a host group or it's subgroups OR they are admins to a group or it's subgroups which has been invited to view all of one of the host groups' activities IF the activity isn't marked 'extra hidden' (under advanced).
configure_tickets_after_creation: Save the activity first. You can configure its tickets on the next page.
activity_read_only: You can view this activity, but only direct administrators of its creator or an organizer group can edit it.
creator: Creator
organizer_not_administered: This creator is not one of the groups you directly administer.
creator_immutable: The creator is fixed after the activity is created.
hosts_invitation_help: Invite new organizers here. An invited group only becomes an organizer after one of its direct administrators accepts. You may only remove an organizer you directly administer.
save_before_inviting_hosts: Save the activity before inviting additional organizers.
delete_activity_confirm: Delete this activity? This cannot be undone.
delete_activity_unavailable: An activity can only be deleted while unpublished, after all ticket kinds have been deleted, and if no notification has been sent.
delete_ticket_kind_confirm: Delete this ticket kind? This cannot be undone.
delete_ticket_kind_unavailable: A ticket kind can only be deleted if it has no buyers, has never been released, and releases more than 20 minutes from now.
replace_ticket_confirm: This ticket kind can no longer be changed. Close its sales and create the edited version as v2?
purchased_ticket_edit_limits: Tickets have been purchased. Pricing, access groups and add-on structure are locked; the remaining settings and bookkeeping allocations can still be changed.
ticket_preset_help: Choose the simplest template that fits. Advanced keeps every setting available.
preset_removes_addons: This template removes the current add-ons. Continue?
preset_requires_one_group: This template requires exactly one access group.
addon_statistics_help: Answers with matching add-on and option names are combined across this activity's ticket kinds.
no_addon_answers: No purchased tickets contain add-on answers yet.
export_all_ticket_purchasers: Export all ticket purchasers as CSV
host_invitations_description: Groups you administer have been invited to organize these activities.
activity_verifiers_help: Grant personal app accounts permission to scan and validate tickets for this activity. The account must already exist.
activity_capacity: Max tickets across all ticket kinds
activity_capacity_help: Normally the min and max are set on individual ticket kinds. For when you want multiple groups to "compete" for tickets, you can set their individual totals higher and this under the total. Then, no more tickets in total for the activity will be sold than is set here but the individual ticket kinds can sell as many as they can.
hide_activity_help: Local activity override: hides this activity from regular users regardless of group visibility settings.
hide_other_admins: Make this activity extra hidden (hides it from the administrators from other groups configured in the group settings)
hide_other_admins_help: Local activity override: administrators invited through another group's settings cannot see it; direct administrators of the creator and organizers still can.
directions_placeholder: For example: Enter through the north entrance
invalid_contact: Responsible contact must begin with mailto: or tel:.
end_after_start: The end date must be after the start date.
limit_max_tickets: Set a maximum number of tickets
capacity_too_low: Maximum tickets cannot be below {minimum} already reserved or purchased tickets.
admin_host_required: Select a group you directly administer as creator.
coordinates_together: Enter both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
invalid_coordinates: The coordinates are outside the valid latitude or longitude range.
invalid_location_url: The location link must be a valid http or https URL.
no_admin_groups: Your account does not administer any group. Ask an existing group administrator to add you.
ticket_release_too_soon: Ticket sales must start at least 10 minutes from now.
external_sales_help: Optionally add transaction fees and sales handled outside Teknologappen before generating the report.
external_report_values_invalid: External fees and sales must have a category and a valid non-negative amount.
money_input_invalid: Enter a non-negative amount with no more than two decimals.
report_download_failed: The report could not be downloaded.
groups_description: Edit groups, membership, administrators and delegated access.
limit_visibility_help: Members of this group will not automatically qualify through broader parent-group ticket rules or notifications; access must target this group directly.
child_group_help: Creates a group directly below this group and starts its path from the lowercase Swedish name.
save_group_before_subgroup: Save this group's changes before creating a subgroup.
invalid_group_path: The group path may only contain lowercase letters, numbers and underscores separated by dots.
child_path_required: A child group path must be exactly one level below its parent path.
group_path_exists: A group with this path already exists.
group_parent_missing: The selected parent group does not exist.
direct_parent_admin_required: Moving a group requires direct administrator access to its new parent.
admin_email_required: Administrators must use a user ID beginning with email:.
last_admin_required: A group must keep at least one administrator.
joiner_groups: Groups whose members may ask to join
activity_admin_groups_help: These admins can see all our (and our subgroups') activities.
delete_group_confirm: Delete this group? Existing references will remain but it will be hidden.
transfer_groups_descendants: Members of selected groups and all descendant groups may receive the ticket.
sync_transfer_settings: Sync all ticket kinds to these settings
allowed_groups: Groups whose members can buy the ticket
allowed_groups_help: Only members in this groups (and it's subgroups) can buy this ticket kind. If this is left blank, no one could buy the ticket.
activity_not_published_notification: The activity is not published. Publish it before scheduling notifications.
notifications_description: Schedule notifications for groups and future activities you administer.
activity_notification_recipients_warning: This notification may be sent to everyone who can see or buy tickets for the activity. Check the recipients carefully before sending.
high_level_group_notification_warning: This is a level 1 or 2 group and may reach a very large number of people.
visible_activity_notification_warning: This will be sent to everyone who can see the activity, which may be a much broader audience than its buyers or ticket holders.
notification_recipient_all: Everyone who can see the activity
notification_recipient_buyers: Everyone who can buy a ticket
group_notification_recipients_warning: This notification is sent to every member of this group and all of its subgroups. Be especially careful when notifying a high-level group.
visibility_access: Visibility access (for those who cannot buy tickets)
visibility_access_help: Choose who can see the activity. Access granted by its ticket kinds is included automatically.
visibility_access_from_ticket_kind: This access comes from a ticket kind and can only be changed in its settings.
organizers_after_creation: The selected organizers will receive invitations after the activity is created.
wizard_partial_failure: The activity was created, but one of its related ticket kinds, organizer invitations, or notifications could not be created. Open the activity to finish the setup.
reused_addon_sync_help: Using an existing addon keeps matching copies synchronized across this activity. Changes are applied to every ticket kind using it.
shared_addon_locked: This addon is shared. Edit it from the activity addon panel to keep every ticket kind synchronized.
shared_addons_panel_help: Addons with identical settings on multiple ticket kinds appear here. Changes and removals are applied to every matching ticket kind when the activity is saved.
override_shared_addon_confirm: Override this shared addon for this ticket kind? Its settings will start to drift from the activity's shared addon.
bookkeeping_report_help: These categories group alcohol sales in the activity's sales report.
ticket_dates_order: Sales and transfer end dates must be after their respective start dates.
ticket_limits_invalid: Ticket limits must be whole, non-negative numbers; minimum must be below maximum unless both are zero.
ticket_capacity_reserved: Maximum tickets cannot be below the number already reserved or purchased.
ticket_addons_invalid: Each addon and option needs a unique UUID, translated names, non-negative prices, and matching bookkeeping amounts and categories that add up to the option price.
invalid_group_ids: Every allowed group ID must be a valid UUID.
purchased_ticket_immutable: Pricing, access groups, addon structure and addon pricing cannot change after a ticket has been purchased.
not_found: The requested item could not be found.
